name: Hadrogaan Soldier (CR 10)
body:
HADROGAAN SOLDIER
CR 10

XP 9,600
Doluma hadrogaan soldier (gunner) 11
N Medium humanoid (hadrogaan)
Init +10; Senses blindsense 30 ft.; Perception +21

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 16, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 deflection, +8 armor)
hp 120 (11d10+33+11+11)
Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +9

Defensive Abilities valor abilities (defensive valor 1d6)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. out of armor)
Melee +1 synthetic warhammer +17/+12/+7 (1d8+7 B, 19–20/×3)
Ranged laser rifle +15/+10/+5 touch (2d6 fire, range incr. 150 ft., automatic) or fragmentation grenade +15 (explode [20-ft., 5d6 S, DC 15])
Special Attacks gear boosts (armored advantage, gear feats [Technologist, Weapon Focus]), primary fighting style (guard), primary fighting style techniques (armor training, guard’s protection, rapid recovery), secondary fighting style (blitz), secondary fighting style techniques (rapid response)

STATISTICS

Str 16 (+3); Dex 18 (+4); Con 16 (+3); Int 10 (+0); Wis 12 (+1); Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +11; CMB +14; CMD 30
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Furious Focus, Improved Critical (warhammer), Improved Initiative (B), Improved Weapon Focus (warhammer), Mobility, Power Attack, Spring Attack, Step Up, Technologist, Toughness, Weapon Focus (warhammer), Weapon Specialization (warhammer)
Skills Climb +15, Disable Device +16, Knowledge (engineering) +14, Perception +21; Species Modifiers +2 Perception
Languages Common, Hadrogaan
SQ dual nervous system, soldier’s onslaught, valor (max. 3 points)
Gear 2 fragmentation grenades; Cybertech skillslot (brain), mark I wirejack tendons (body); Other Gear +1 thinplate, laser rifle; +1 synthetic warhammer, belt of mighty constitution +2, cloak of resistance +1, ring of protection +1, mark II skillchip (Perception), 2 silverdisk batteries (10 charges each), credit stick (75 gp)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dual Nervous System (Ex)

See above.

ECOLOGY

Hadrogaans are an odd species of humanoids that are in a symbiotic relationship with a sentient species of opalescent crystals known as kallestrine.

They place these crystals in large, pockmark-like hollows that appear naturally along their 8-foot tall bodies.

All hadrogaans have broad heads, brightly colored skin, three-fingered hands, and elongated three-toes hooves. However, they are a dimorphic species, with distinct differences between two different groups based on how they respond to the kallestrine. Those known as “lumas” are slightly taller but thinner, and have bodies with many kallestrine, whereas the “dolumas” are slightly shorter but broader and stronger, and have fewer of the symbiotic crystals set in their bodies.

No one seems to know exactly where the hadrogaans originated, but they have several colonies throughout the Galaxy.

While hadrogaan planets tend to all be independent from each other, many of them cooperate on some level. Most hadrogaans are pragmatic to a fault. However, they can be hard to decipher. While some are quite open to trade and dialogue with their neighbors, others can be antagonistic and warlike. Regardless, they are not to be taken lightly.
